envelope.description: Mount the slot from renderContent — the one call that changes what a reviewer sees

body.title: Mount the slot from renderContent — the one call that changes what a reviewer sees
body.summary: Call the factory from renderContent AFTER stampSlugs (the pointer-advance constraint the shipped code states at :586) and before the chooser and the notice, wrapped in the backstop catch S002 established, then mount the slot: anchored beside the heading whose slug the ref's ofSectionId resolved to via sc3's shipped createSectionResolver (docs-sections.ts:136-149), at the defined default position otherwise. Deliberately a single call and deliberately last, so reverting it restores the shipped surface while leaving the types, the data path and both derivations in place. The gate's own mutations run here.
acceptanceChecks: THE FOUR-COMBINATION GATE asserted as a TABLE, one row per (ref × record): absent+absent → 'absent'; present+present → 'rendered'; present+absent → 'unshowable'; absent+present → 'rendered' (the resolved contested row, q7f574776 — record gates content)

ac2's dominant path proved as ZERO DOM ACTIVITY: for a document with no ref and no record the slot path makes NO createElement call at all, and the rendered BODY REGION plus the slot host are unchanged relative to the IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING commit — pinned against the CURRENT post-renderer baseline, not against S002's, which the source-string tasks have already moved
`classes: {}` and an empty sequence record are treated as ABSENT, matching the undefined-or-empty convention the repo states twice
A diagram-mermaid ref with no projected record routes to 'unshowable' with a reason that NAMES what was referenced, and `diagram-html` routes there too per lc1 — never a silent nothing
A forced throw inside the slot build leaves the body, the chooser, the notice, the open questions and BOTH approval controls intact — all five surfaces asserted

IDEMPOTENCE: two consecutive docs-content messages with the same record leave exactly ONE slot with the same content; a third carrying neither leaves none — against a stub whose innerHTML/textContent assignment REPLACES children, or the test is meaningless

An ofSectionId that resolves mounts the slot beside that heading; one that does not resolve mounts it at the DEFAULT position rather than dropping the visual (the live path — 0 of 8 real refs carry the field)
docs-sections.ts comes out BYTE-IDENTICAL — this Story mints no section identity
The approval path, the COMMENTABLE_KINDS gate and the blocked banner behave identically to before the Story

MUTATIONS RUN AND REVERTED, each turning its named test RED: delete the absent gate (zero-DOM-activity); dispatch on the ref's kind instead of the record present (sequence-diagram unshowable); drop the diagram-html branch (lc1); drop linkOut from 'unshowable' (link-in-failure-state)
